column2: The 30-row cap: an area's grid has at most 30 rows (fixed array at +0xbcb; Area::layout shows the "Area.cpp 507" box above that, and Area::init already writes the weights outside the array). \n At 1920 × 1080 the report of an old match asks for more; capped at 30, the rest goes to the scroll bar, as at 800 × 600 (where it never exceeds 30 and the cap changes nothing). \n It lives in Area::init because the start of Display::add_area (0x55fba0) is already a detour of the 1080 exe (coordinate scaling).
The comparer's dry run of 0x447430: the copy runs without sorting the tables (the original routine, which runs first, has already sorted them).

The fans' rating of player `p` at the club from stats `st` (0x452da0). \n Average (+0xe signed / games +0) + 0.025 × +2 + 1/60 × +6. The club likes him (0x547790): +0.2; does not like him (0x5477d0): −2 (stored); he likes the club (0x547d60): +0.2; does not like it (0x547d30): −1.5 (only in the comparison).

The calls 0x5223a0 makes to 0x4a2540 (Comp_Stats set_club_final_position: club, position), in order, with the vector `v` already sorted. \n From the second-to-last round (+0x3c − 2) backward ([+0xa3] + r × 0x68, the count of who goes out in +0x1a), until a null club at the start of the round. In the first round seen, those who go out in it all get position 1 (without checking for nulls); in each round, the following ones get the counter's position (which goes up with every slot, null or not), skipping the nulls. \n `gravar` = 0 only builds the list. Returns the (club, position) list.

Builds the round's draw date (+0 the day, +2 the year as a byte relative to the cup's +0x40) into a local Date. \n 0x549ef0: push year; push day; ecx = the local; no add esp -> thiscall, ret 8; both are in registers with garbage in the high bits, and the Rust only reads the words.

The two clubs (ids) that 0x519fc0 sends to the UEFA seeding (semi-final losers not in the final), or None when it exits without sending anything. \n Round 0x82 (the semi-finals) and 0x96 (the final), both found; it walks the fixtures of 0x82 and the teams that are not in the first fixture of 0x96: the first becomes a, the second b (then it stops); a team of −1 (still without a fixture) cancels; if one is missing, −1.

Body of 0x51c020: the winning side of a fixture (goals, extra time, penalties) as `Some(side)`, or `None` on a draw that is also level on penalties under their rule. \n The original routine shows the "Error" box with line 0x97e and goes on to walkover and points: the caller runs the whole original routine, which redoes the only thing already written (+0x3d/+0x3e = 1 with bit 0x10, idempotent).

The virtual +0x3c (`create_schedule(fase, &rodadas, &extra, &é_liga)`, thiscall, ret 0x10) for the chosen stage `f`; sets the outputs and returns the table. \n Group stages: é_liga (if requested) = 1, rounds, extra; the table of 0x41 bytes per round (0x944e46; out of memory, the box and 0) with the dates, the year +0x40 in 16 bits. \n Knockout: é_liga = 0, rounds, extra = 0; the table of 0x68 bytes per round (out of memory, the box and 0), the rounds written by `eng_cc_cup_write_cup_round` with the year +0x40 signed and the extra words.

`EngAutoCup::select_section_clubs()` (0x56b730, thiscall, ret 0, eng_auto_cup.cpp; from the season rollover, n = 1 up to 2002-06-01): puts the 56 League Trophy clubs (+0xb6 = 0x38) in a list (0x944e46 of 0xe0 at +0xb2; out of memory, the box for line 0x24c and 0), in four steps, each one until the list is full (count == +0xb6). 
 1) In club table order ([0xae23b4], [0xae235c] clubs), those of divisions [0x9cf5c4] and [0x9cf5c8] (the English second and third divisions [inference]). 
 2) The first club of division [0x9cf69c] (the Conference [inference]) that came from [0x9cf5c8] (+0x5b, the previous season's division [inference]): the relegated club; it is remembered (`achado`) so it does not enter again. 
 3) If the cup's nation ([+4] +0x5d) has bit 4 in +0x11c, the clubs of [0x9cf69c] that were already in it (+0x5b), by category +0x5f (signed): first those of 6 or less, then 7, 8... until full; otherwise, up to 30 clubs of [0x9cf69c] (except the remembered one) and, if short, the English clubs (+0x53 = [0x9cf2e4]) outside the generic division [0x9cf764] (among the first [0xae235c] − 2 × [0xae2350]), up to 30, sorted by reputation with the first 3 × missing shuffled (comp_util_sort_and_shuffle_top_clubs 0x4afbd0: push missing; push how many; push list; add esp, 0xc -> cdecl; uses random draws), and of those the first ones still missing. 
 Once full, the list is sorted by the latitude of the stadium's city (qsort 0x945333 with 0x53fd40) and each half (the North and the South [inference]) by reputation, lowest to highest (qsort with 0x4b0810); returns 1. If it does not fill, 0.

A cup round (record of 0x68 bytes, docs/.md §2.4). \n The draw (day, month with 0 = January, years to add to the cup's year +0x40, weekday or −1) via 0x521e60; the match (the same, plus the leg at +6 and the home side at +0x13) via 0x521eb0. \n Then the fields: +7 the round name, +9 the index, +0xb the draw bits, +0xd and +0xf the tie-breakers (single match and two legs), +0x17 the category copied into each match, +0x18/+0x1a/+0x1c/+0x1e teams, matches, new teams and entrants already in, +0x20/+0x21/+0x22 replay, matches per tie and days between them, +0x5c/+0x60/+0x64 the prize money (reaching, winning, losing).

A cup round (record of 0x68 bytes, docs/.md §2.4). \n The draw (day, month with 0 = January, years to add to the cup's year +0x40, weekday or −1) via 0x521e60; the match (the same, plus the leg at +6 and the home side at +0x13) via 0x521eb0. \n Then the fields: +7 the round name, +9 the index, +0xb the draw bits, +0xd and +0xf the tie-breakers (single match and two legs), +0x17 the category copied into each match, +0x18/+0x1a/+0x1c/+0x1e teams, matches, new teams and entrants already in, +0x20/+0x21/+0x22 replay, matches per tie and days between them, +0x5c/+0x60/+0x64 the prize money (reaching, winning, losing).

The stage of group `g` of an Italian cup (`create_group_stage(g)`): builds the League_Stage of group g with the next entrants from +0xee, stores it in [+0xc][g], sends the draw news and sets +0x30 = g. 
 SEH frame only for the new: no destructor on the normal path. Shared template of the Coppa Italia and Serie C, checked instruction by instruction: only the source file and the box lines change. 
 The round table via the cup's method +0x3c (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push g; mov ecx -> thiscall, ret 0x10); a vector of +0x3e pointers (0x944e46, cdecl; out of memory, the box of `linhas[0]` and 0) with the first +0x3e entrants still in the list (+0xee, vector of pointers: the non-null ones, in order, each zeroed as it leaves). 
 The stage (0x944cf1(0xee), cdecl; the League_Stage constructor 0x68b100, thiscall, ret 0x58, 22 arguments: the cup, the teams (word +0x3e), the vector, 1, +4, the round table, the rounds (word), +0xc2, +0xc3, +0xc4, &+0xc5, &+0xbe, the year +0x40 (word), g, the id (word), +0x51, 1, 0, +0xd9 (word), −1, 0, 2; the original pushes the words and bytes with garbage in the high bytes, which the constructor does not read: the copy passes clean values) is stored in [+0xc][g]; the vector and the round table are freed (0x9452ca). 
 No stage: the box of `linhas[1]` and 0. With it: the group draw news (0x684230 on the stage), +0x30 = g and 1.

`ItaCup::select_entrants()` (0x63faf0, thiscall, ret 0, ita_cup.cpp): the 48 Coppa Italia entrants (+0xf2 = 0x30; the list of 0xc0 bytes at +0xee; out of memory, the box for line 0x2e1 and 0). Returns 1. 
 The 32 for the groups go into a local vector: the Italian clubs of the season (single pass) that did not come from Serie B ([0x9cf574]) among the top 3 nor from Serie A ([0x9cf570]) among the top 15: those in the current Serie B, those that came from Serie B in 4th, 5th or below 17th, and those that came from C1 ([0x9cf578]/[0x9cf57c]) in 4th, 5th or 6th; if short, those of C1 outside Serie B by position (6th, 7th...). 
 The vector goes to qsort (0x640590) and is split into 4 pots of 8: 8 passes, each takes one randomly drawn club from each pot (0x90cfc0(8), moving to the next in the pot if it was already taken). 
 Then the top 3 of the previous Serie B and those of the previous Serie A from 10th to 15th (until reaching 48) and, without checking first, the top 9 of the previous Serie A.

`JapJCup::collect_entrants()` (0x665a00, thiscall, ret 0, jap_j_cup.cpp): 28 entrants (+0x3e = 28); the list (0x944e46 of 0xa8 at +0xa7; out of memory, the box for line 0x11a and −1). \n The J2 clubs ([0x9cf768]) while they fit, class 0; the J1 clubs ([0x9cf65c]) while they fit, each with a random class from 0 to 19 (0x90cfc0(20), after writing the club); qsort (0x522190) of the 16 entries from the 11th (+0x42). \n Returns 1 with the list full, otherwise 0 (as the result and count pair).

`JapSuper::select_teams()` (0x666160, thiscall, ret 0, jap_super.cpp): the J1 champion and the Emperor's Cup winner. The list (out of memory, the box for line 0xc1 and −1). \n The J1 champion ([0x9cf65c]; without it, 0xca and 0) — with no nation (+0x53 = 0), the runner-up (without it, 0xd6 and 0); the Emperor's Cup winner ([0x9cf660]; without it, 0xe0 and 0) — with no nation, the runner-up (without it, 0xec and 0). \n If they are the same club, the second becomes the Emperor's Cup runner-up (without it, 0xf9 and 0) and, if still the same, the first becomes the J1 runner-up (without it, 0x105 and 0). Returns 1.

The 8 group-stage teams: the survivors (+5 = 1 in the 6-byte table) of the first zone's knockout (the cup's table, +0xa7) up to 4, then those of the second zone's knockout (table +0xa7 of stage [+0xc][0]) up to 8. \n Both searches go up to the cup's +0x3e (signed word). Returns the 8 (leftover slots stay 0: the original routine leaves them with stack leftovers).

`AsiaClubChamp::create_semi_final_stage()` (0x40c3d0, thiscall, ret 0, asia_club_champ.cpp; SEH frame only for the stage's new: no destructor on the normal path): builds the 4-team semi-final stage of the Asian Club Championship. 
 The list of 4 (0x944e46(0x10): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the box for line 0x3d1 and return), with the pairings of asia_semi_finalists; the round table via the virtual +0x3c (push 0; push &id; push &rounds; push 3; mov ecx, this -> thiscall, ret 0x10).

 No stage: the box for line 0x3e6 and return (the list is not freed, as in the original). With it: the draw of round 0 (0x51c410 Cup::draw_round: push 0; mov ecx, stage -> thiscall, ret 4) and the list freed.

The stages of the Asian Champions League [inference: the Asian Club Championship]. \n −1 and 0 each zone's qualifiers (2 two-legged rounds in August and September), 1 and 2 the final groups (3 rounds in March), 3 the final stage (semi-final, third place and final in May).

The four lists of 0x4c11a0 (Mexican, Central American, Caribbean and MLS clubs) with their counts. \n Built in the order of the club database ([0xae23b4], 0x245 bytes, [0xae235c] clubs; it stops at the first one that is a national team, 0x53b900).

The knockout plan (the comparer runs only the original routine: the list, the table and the stage are allocated and the round is drawn). \n The qualifiers are read first (group 1 in the rows, the stages through the rows of their table +0xb1, like 0x6826d0); then the stage in [+0xc][`mata`] is checked: +0x3e = `times`, the cup's +4, and the clubs of its list (+0xa7, 6 bytes) equal to the plan's as a set (the draw may reorder them).
A nation's clubs for the Merconorte: up to 30, in club table order.

`ConMercCup::select_invited_clubs()` (0x4c2560, thiscall, ret 0, con_merc_cup.cpp): builds the 16 invited clubs from Mexico, Colombia, Peru, Bolivia and the MLS, shuffled. +0xf2 = 16 and the list +0xee (0x944e46(0x40): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the box for line 0x262 and returns 0). 
 The clubs of the table ([0xae23b4], 0x245 bytes, [0xae235c] of them; the first national team, 0x53b900 database_is_national_team: push club; add esp, 4 -> cdecl, ends the search) with a nation (+0x53) go, by the nation's id (its +0), to the lists of Mexico ([0x9cf3d0]), Colombia ([0x9cf29c]), Peru ([0x9cf428]) and Bolivia ([0x9cf254]), up to 30 in each; those of another nation whose league (+0x57) is [0x9cf590] (the MLS) go to the American league list, up to 12. 
 Each list is sorted by reputation and has its top band shuffled (0x4afbd0 comp_util_sort_and_shuffle_top_clubs: push how many; push the count (word); push list; add esp, 0xc -> cdecl; uses random draws): Mexico 4, Colombia 5, Peru 3, Bolivia 2, the American league 2. 
 The list: in slots 2..5 the top 4 of Mexico, 6..10 the 5 of Colombia, 11..13 the 3 of Peru, 14..15 the 2 of Bolivia; in slots 0 and 1, without the American league competition ([[0xadadfc] + 4 × [0x9cf728]] = 0) the top 2 of its list; with it, the champion of the last record of competition [0x9cf590] (0xae23d0 + 0x6b × id) and that of its competition +4 (0x4afd80 comp_util_get_latest_placed_club: push place; push competition; add esp -> cdecl), and, if they are the same club, the runner-up of the first in slot 0. 
 The list is shuffled (0x4afb40(list, 16): push; push; add esp, 8 -> cdecl; 3 × 16 random swaps). Returns 1. 
 The original keeps the lists on the stack without zeroing them: with fewer clubs than slots, it reads leftovers; the copy reads zero [inference: in this career the four nations and the MLS have enough clubs; the comparer checks the list].

`IntertotoCup::collect_entrants()` (0x6336c0, thiscall, ret 0, intertoto_cup.cpp): the 60 clubs whose European cup (+0x1db) is the Intertoto, put in the team list (+0xa7) with their coefficient as class and sorted. \n +0x3e = 60; a local vector of 60 pointers (0x944e46 of 0xf0; out of memory, the box for line 0x161 and 0) with the clubs of the table ([0xae23b4], up to [0xae235c]) whose European cup (+0x1db) is the Intertoto ([0x9cf6f8]), up to 60; if short, the box for line 0x172 and 0 (the vector stays allocated, as in the original). \n The list (0x944e46 of 6 × 60 at +0xa7; out of memory, the box 0x17c and −1) takes each club with class = its coefficient (+0x1df) and status 0, goes to qsort (0x522190) and the vector is freed. Returns 1 with the 60 (as the result pair).

The reference dates of the host decisions (Date::set 0x54a130: day of the month, month from 0, year 1997, no weekday): their day of the year goes into +0x1f of the entries of the following loop.

`AfricanNations::draw_finalists()` (0x4022c0, thiscall, ret 0, african_nations.cpp): hosts first, then African nations by reputation, drawn from 4 pots into 4 groups of 4 stored in +0xee. 
 +0xf2 (word) = 16 and the list +0xee of 50 (0x944e46(0xc8): push; add esp, 4 -> cdecl; out of memory, the box for line 0x349 and returns 0). 
 First the hosts of the African Cup of Nations ([0x9cf7ac]) in year +0x40 (0x5fa730 HostCountry::find_hosts on [0xb5e134]: push 1; push &second; push &first; push year; push competition -> thiscall, ret 0x14; returns how many, signed byte; the outputs are only read up to the count), each one via its national team (0x53b3d0 database_get_national_team: push nation; add esp -> cdecl; the nations in [0xae23a8], 0x122 bytes). 
 Then, in nation order ([0xae2350], i as a word), those of the African continent ([0x9cfa08]; the nation's +0x71, its +0) while there are fewer than 50, except the hosts (+0x53 of the national team). Fewer than 16: returns 0 (no box; the list stays in +0xee). 
 Those after the hosts are sorted by reputation (qsort 0x945333 with 0x4b07d0: 4 pushes; add esp -> cdecl). 
 The groups (0x944e46(0x40); out of memory, the box for line 0x380 and returns 0): for each group j (0..3) and pot p (0..3), one randomly drawn (0x90cfc0(4): push 4; add esp -> cdecl; the signed byte; again while the pot's slot was already taken) among the 4 of the pot (the list in slots 4p to 4p + 3) goes to slot 4j + p of the groups and leaves the pot (zeroed). 
 The list is freed (0x9452ca) and +0xee = the groups. Returns 1.
The 12 nations of the 2001 Copa América, in list order (the groups interleaved: A in slots 0, 3, 6 and 9; B in 1, 4, 7 and 10; C in 2, 5, 8 and 11): the globals of the nations' ids.

One operation of building the round table, in the original routine's order. \n `D` the date of a group round (0x68a160: round, day, month with 0 = January, years to add, weekday, code, value; records of 0x41 bytes), `L` a match of the group round (0x68a1c0: round, match, a, b, c, value), `S` the draw of a cup round (0x521e60: round, day, month, years, weekday; records of 0x68 bytes), `J` the match of the cup round (0x521eb0: round, day, month, years, weekday, time, home side), `E` a day of the tie (0x521f10: round, slot, weekday, time, code, home side) and `B`/`W`/`X` writing a byte/word/dword at the given offset of the table.

With +0x8ebb: 0x2120 if the side is ahead on aggregate, otherwise 0x2121 when the average of +0x1b of the starters is low and the other club's strength (+0x80) weighs. \n At the end, for side 1 without +0x1a8: 0x2001 if the match is still not decided.

Comparer for `national_teams_post_call_up_news` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Comparer of 0x76e0b0: it only builds and delivers news items (allocating in the humans' inboxes) and builds and frees the opponents list: it cannot run twice and writes nothing of the game besides the inboxes. \n Only the original routine runs (simplification: the effect is the human's inbox; the opponents list is checked through 0x76d560).

Comparer for `select_squads_for_fixture` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The original routine runs first; the copy afterwards, as a dry run, from the same records of the two nations (+0x32 to +0x6c: today's marks, squad dates and call-up marks). \n If the copy requested any squad (0x76c120 allocates and touches the squads), the comparison does not count and the original stands; otherwise the records must match.

Comparer for `national_teams_can_change_squad` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Side by side on the return value and the reason (the original routine in the destination, the copy in its own destination of the same size). Both move the cursor of list [this] the same way; the search for the day's matches builds and frees a local list (no lasting state). \n No nation or a short destination (the box): only the original.

Comparer for `officials_manager_add_random_officials` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The routine reallocates and sorts (it cannot run twice): only the original routine, after a dry run. The dry run generates the copy's `conta` sheets (generate_official, without counting the random draws) in its own area from the same random generator state, which is restored; then the original runs. \n It checks the final random state, the new count ([0xae2390] + conta) and that each sheet from the dry run is in the sorted table (fields the original writes). Non-positive count or nation without a continent: only the original.

Comparer for `archive_player_stats` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs), as a dry run (model RARE_FINANCE_EVENT_DRY_RUN). \n The copy runs first without writing to the file (the nodes it would write go into the sum of matches and goals), then the original routine from the same state; compares the return value, the six 32-byte category records and the matches and goals for the club (+0x20/+0x22 of the player sheet's record). \n The history positions (+0x18, +0x1c), which only the original's write moves, are left out. Null person or no player sheet: only the original.

Comparer for `send_scout_reports` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Comparer of 0x7f9890: the original routine delivers news items (allocating in the inboxes), so only it runs, with logging of the calls to 0x7f9a60 turned on; beforehand, the copy as a dry run (without 0x7f9a60) gives the groups (player, club, how many) in order, and the original's calls must be those.

Comparer for `try_loan_offer_for_player` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The copy as a dry run and the original routine from the same state ([0xae1080], the random generator and the statics of the date operations). \n The copy refused (−1): the original too, with the same memory. The copy would update the list (−3): the original returns −1. The copy would make the offer (−2): the original does not return −1.

Comparer for `add_month_award_record` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n The manager side by side on his points record (created beforehand by 0x86f5b0, as the original would; the copy without the history entry in the file). \n The player case draws at random, renews the contract and sends a news item (it cannot run twice): only the original routine. No person or no award (the box): only the original.

Comparer for `make_exchange_option` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Comparer of 0x8c8860: side by side from the same state of [0xae1080], *saida, *atracao and the random generator (0x8e78f0 draws at random); the copy runs without counting random draws. \n It checks the return value, the attraction, [0xae1080] and the snapshot of each side's new offer; the copy's offer is destroyed (0x8e5710) and freed (0x944c94) and everything stays as the original left it.

Comparer for `transfer_manager_daily_update` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Comparer of 0x8c5880: only the original routine runs (it processes the offers, which change squads, finances and news). It checks what it guarantees, against the previous state: running the day (today equal to the base and the slice equal to +0x855), in slice 2 the base becomes tomorrow, +0x855 goes back to 0 and +0x84c goes up (from 49 to 0); in the others +0x855 goes up by 1. \n And on day 100 of slice 2 each person who meets the condition (the loop is the last step, so the state afterwards is its own) ends up with +0x1e (the second nationality) = the club's nation: the day-100 naturalisation.

Comparer for `can_club_bid_for_player` (comparison mode: see the header of motor.rs). \n Side by side on the reason, the person's mark (+0x86e), the free queue cursor and the return value. \n The other writes (clearing mark 0x40, marking +0x2d of the offer under negotiation) the copy repeats over what the original routine left and arrives at the same result.

The comparer's dry run: the copy runs without the loan offer (0x8bed60) or the list update (0x843e10), which allocate and touch the lists; it returns −2 where it would make the offer and −3 where it would update the list.

The morale drop (the original's byte `m`) after a bad match, or None when the routine exits without touching anything (some null, the club's manager or assistant +0xcf/+0xd3, or outside job 0xb). \n x = (rating +0xb − club reputation) + 50 × days at the club (since +0x3e, up to 400) + 417 × age − 31680. With the contract days (since +0x2d) above 400 (never: the cap is 400) and age 24..31: + 250 × +0x57 + 5000; otherwise, with +0x22 and the nation's reputation (+0x1a +0x8e) above 3500 and under 32 years old: + 250 × +0x57 + 25 × +0x22 + 2500; otherwise by the contract band (+0x4f >> 4): 1: + 250 × +0x57 + 5000; 2: + 125 × +0x57 + 2500; 3: + 1000 × +0x3e; in these cases at most 15000. \n y = 1 − x × (6.667e-4 if x < 0, otherwise 6e-5), between 0.1 and 10; m = ftol((+0x3e + 4) / y + 0.5) (byte). Double precision; the constants come from .rdata.
The names of languages 1..64 of 0x53cee0 (code immediates, by their addresses in the exe; 34 repeats Albanian), all with the empty 0xad9c64 ("<%s - COMMENT - language>").

The B team linked to `clube` (club_get_linked_b_team 0x540a50 at the game's address, with `ativo` = 1): the partner's record or 0; `eh_a` gets 1 (the club is the A team) or 0 (the club is the B team) when there is a partner. \n When refused, 0x540a50 clears the club's mark +0x244: in the comparison the original routine comes first and the copy finds the mark already cleared (also 0).

How many of the 50 in the squad (+0xd7) count: a non-null person with a player (+0x61) of `posicao`, not badly injured (INJURY 0x62c400 on [0xb63d28] ≠ 2), id (+0) < [0xae2364] (signed), current ability (the player's +5, signed short) above `limite`, and the `extra` predicate (the player's attributes). \n Like count_squad_above_ability but also requiring `extra`. In the original's order (0x62c400 only for those of the position). 8-bit counter (at most 50).

How many of the 50 in the squad (+0xd7) are a person with a player (+0x61) of `posicao`, not badly injured (INJURY 0x62c400 on [0xb63d28] ≠ 2), id (+0) < [0xae2364] (signed), current ability (+5, signed short) above reputation/75 + 25 (from 40 to 135), and pass `extra` with the attribute threshold reputation/500 + 5 (at most `teto`). \n Reputation: the club's +0x80, signed short. In the original's order. 8-bit counter (at most 50).

The shared rebalancing of 0x538bc0 and 0x538ec0 over the player's attribute vector (0x53a610: signed word + weight per cell), on cells from `inicio` (end of the sides + 2) up to before `fim` (end of the weighted ones), excluding those in `pular`. \n Two passes: (1) limit 30, +5 per round, up to 12 cells with |value| ≤ limit (marked); the one with the highest value outside the limit is also marked; (2) adds `alvo` − average to the marked ones (clamped to −125..125); in the 1st pass, with the player's +0xf < 15, the unmarked positive ones go into the excess (cells 0x11 and 0x12 via `excesso`), the rest are marked; with cell 0 < 15, those of weight 1 become −120; (3) with more than one in the excess and sum > 85, takes (sum − 85) / count from the unmarked ones (minimum 0). \n The original's frame is not read uninitialised: the cells of the range all come from 0x53a610.

A version-1 database converter (Db_files.cpp): for each of the `n` records of `tamanho` bytes, the fields in file order, `(deslocamento, tamanho, quantos)`, each read on its own (`tamanho`, 1) by `zread` 0x932c30 (use_zip ≠ 0) or `fread` 0x945bfe. \n Size 0 = one byte from the file that becomes a u16 (`reputacao`) at offset + 2k (the original reads the byte into an argument on its own stack, already used, and writes the u16 before the next read). \n The first read that does not come back gives 0 (what has already been read stays in the record); all of them, 1. The bytes the file does not provide (holes in the record) stay as they were.

The read-only plan of a match for a ban (only reads; 0x7e82e0 without creating, and 0x54c5b0 only writes its scratch date): the person's suspension in the body of `regra`; reports completion. \n By matches (+0 ≠ 0xff): from the start (day +4, year +6; today [0xae2c90]: day +0, year +2), with `conta`, +1 on the counter (+1), and it ends on reaching +0. \n By days (+0 = 0xff): it ends when today reaches start + days (+2) (0x54c5b0).

The core of set_key_ids after the -1 (the -1 belongs to each entry): resolves the fixed key ids (colours, clubs, continents, competitions, nations, awards) from eng.lng or the database and reports the missing ones. Returns 1. 
 `marca` = edi at entry (-1 in the original; MARCA_DAS_CHAVES_1080 in the 1080 exe, which only holds if no loop runs); `relatar` = the report of keys without a value (in comparison mode the copy runs without it, so the box does not appear twice). 
 1) The colours ([0xae2394] of [0xae23ec] + 4, step 0x3a): CORES_DAS_CHAVES. 
 2) With [0x9b5984] ≠ 0 and CM3_TEMP\eng.lng open: 8 counts (bytes swapped if 0x90c140(f) = 0xf1fffff1) and the tables in file order: clubs c0 × 0x4f (0x6146b0; through list [0xae23fc] up to [0xae235c], if present), continents c1 × 0xba, competitions c2 × 0x53 (0x60efd0 with row c5 + i), nations c3 × 0x6d (0x60d810), skips c6 × 0x34 and c4 × 0x34, awards c7 × 0x4f (0x6115e0), competitions c5 × 0x53 (0x60efd0); a table out of memory: fseek past it. 
 3) Otherwise, from the database: nations (0x60d810), club competitions up to [0xae2378] − 0x7f (0x60efd0), continents, awards (0x6115e0) and clubs (0x6146b0). 
 4) The report (RELATO_DAS_CHAVES): 0x60d780 (the box "Unable to find the %s index"); the 7 fatal ones quit the game if the key's nation has byte +0x11c.

The ids of the national-team tournaments outside the World Cup: Olympics, European Championship, European Championship qualifiers, African Cup of Nations [0x9cf7ac], Copa América, B team, under-21, Oceania Nations Cup, Confederations Cup and Asian Cup.

The rating of one line-up row (0x49 bytes; `e` points to the rating byte at +0x1c0/+0x1c4): the byte that enters the averages (0 = left out); None when not used. \n With the match's +0x4c, the 11 starters count as 90; substitutes (k ≥ 11) only with the entry byte (e − 2 ≠ 0xff) and minus it. \n `nota`, `troca` are the offsets of the two bytes tried in order (the first ≥ 0 counts; otherwise the match's +0x4d).

The contract flags that the manager's departure clears: read by 0x8676f0 (+0x40; 0x10000000 is cleared by 0x8674e0, which touches +0x45) and read in +0x45 (cleared by 0x8674e0, which also updates the person).

0x6b79a0 (cdecl, match_day.cpp; called twice at 0x6b61a9/0x6b61bd, once per club) with calls injected: the post-match news of `clube` after the match against `outro`. 
 No club, other club or match: error box. No manager (+0xcf): nothing; without 0x600a50, with +0x80 below 4750 and random(100) != 0: nothing. 
 With 0x6b7cf0, match +0x40 and +0x41 and the club not out (0x53b900): among the 50 of +0xd7, with a contract (0x4cf5a0) without +0x45, the player sheet's +0xb above 4250, +0x59 above 5, +0x57 above 15, +0x58 above 10, `n` above 2 and random(n) != 0: 0x5896d0(person, club, other, n) and end (the turnaround story for a senior player). 
 Then, the 20 of the club's row in record `t` (side by club at t+0; rows of 0x49 from +0x1ce, person at -0x3e, only those with +0 in the row): player sheet, youth product, age (+0x18) up to 20, contract without +0x45, the match of the club's competition (+0x14 = +0x57, with +0x40/+0x41), the club not out, +0x59 above 15, +0x57 above random(5) + 10, the player sheet's +0xb below 4250 and 0x7c3a40 zero: 0x589bc0 and, without 0x547d60, 0x547d90(person, club, 1), and end (a pleased youngster favouring the club).

0x6bac40 (match_eng.cpp) with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected (0x6d6f70 commentates, 0x716e10 tires): applies the pending incident at +0x475a, clears it and returns 1; 0 if none or discarded. 
 Fields: type; +0x4761 who committed it, +0x4765 who suffered it, +0x475b/+0x475c where, +0x475d/+0x475e/+0x4769 for the punishment, +0x475f the code. No type returns 0. With a set piece in progress (+0x8eb2) and the incident from the side that already had the advantage (+0x8eae) behind the marked position (+0x8ea8), it discards the incident and returns 0; otherwise commentates 0x20f0. 
 Type 8: commentates 0x20ee, counts on the side's score (+0xf5ca) and on the player (+0x13) and marks set piece 7. Without a victim, the foul punishment (0x6e9630) and commentary 0x20fb; with one, the incident punishment (0x6ea4e0) and commentary by code +0x475f (0x20fc to 0x2107). 
 The returned type picks the card (0x1ff9 yellow, 0x1ff7/0x1ff8 red, 0x1ff5 or 0x1ff6 depending on the case, 0x210a by severity against random(7) + 2). Type 7 and set piece 7; near the opposing area (+0x475b from 2 to 6 and +0x475c in the goal band) a penalty (5, 0x1f7a, -500 in +0x35 of the victim or the offender); otherwise a free kick (6, 0x1f79). 
 With a card: 1 in 4 commentates 0x2109 (and 0x20f5 by severity), commentates the card, and a sending-off removes the player (0x6cda20). Outside the set-piece codes, 1 in 9 commentates 0x20df (1 in 3 also 0x20e0) and, with a sending-off or penalty, marks +0x16 of the offender (1 in 7 commentates 0x20d9); the offender's team is worn down by the punishment's weight (0x716450: the offender himself by the weight, those outside p / 6 + 0.83, the others (p + 1) / 2) and the offender tires (0x716e10). Clears the incident and returns 1.

The pre-match events of each player on the pitch (0x6b8d9b to 0x6b9745). \n The contract (0x4cf5f0) and the position marks (0x5481a0 against 0x717400/0x717450) give contract unhappiness (0x13, with points from the player sheet); his reputation against the club's, the other club's interest (0x1e); the form from the average (0x7c1e30) and the index of [0xb74350], 5 or 4; the contract ending soon (0x54cdb0), 6.

0x6cda20 (ret 8, match_eng.cpp) with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected (0x6e1aa0 and 0x6e1090 of the staff, 0x897760 writes the captain): `j` leaves the pitch (injury or sending-off). 
 Without `ja_fora`, adds to +0x23, writes the minute (+0x8ed0 / 11, at most the end of the period: 45, 90, 105, 120) in +0x21 and removes him from the grid (0x6cdd50 with -3). He ends up with +0x19 = -3. In matches with a human manager (the side's +0x904d, 0x5fd210/0x5fd480), it only continues with +0x904b and outside national teams. With +0x1a3 it stops. 
 Goalkeeper (table 1) with the side's +0x9049: the staff swap the goalkeeper (0x6e1090 with 1). Otherwise the staff rebuild the team (0x6e1aa0 and 0x6e1090 with 0); if he was the captain (0x897590), the best rated (0x6e1a40) becomes captain (0x897760); it zeroes the side's position-1 player and recomposes it (0x6ce110). 
 Outside matches with a human manager it stores the substitution minute (+0x8ecc + 2 x side). At the end it rebuilds the side's strength (0x6bbb60) and the individual marking (0x6bbf60).

0x6bcbd0 (ret 0xc, match_eng.cpp) with the list copy injected (0x68d0d0), without random draws: sums into `*saida` the pressure of the active opponents in `j`'s cell (the list for that side on the grid) and returns how many weigh (2 per marker). \n Whoever marks `j` (0x714c60) counts (0x6f4600 + 0x10a - `j`'s +0x19c / 20 - `j`'s +0x107) x 1.7; the others standing (+0x2b >= 0), outside table 1 (0x717410) and with +0x10a or bit 0x100 of +0x198, count (0x10a - ...) x 1.7 / (+0x2b + 1). \n With `lista`, the two that weigh the most (above 5) go into it as a 0x1be-byte copy.

0x6cc540 (ret 0x18, match_eng.cpp) with the search (0x6cd3d0 in mode 1) injected: does anyone intercept on the path from (x, y) to the goal centre (x 4; y 11 with `gol` = 1, otherwise 0)? \n The cells are walked Bresenham-style, from the starting one to the goal's; in each one it draws at random (2) the side that tries first and searches both (table distance from the start, or 1000). \n Returns the first non-zero code; 0 on leaving the grid or arriving. The engine's +0xf5ae is zeroed at the start.

Like `call_recording`, for a unit that reads and writes buffers by pointer (on the caller's stack, outside the regions): records the bytes of the `entradas` (inputs) before and of the `saidas` (outputs) after. \n The Rust copy requests its own (`request_buffers`) before calling: the inputs are checked and the outputs written.

0x6bbe40 (match_eng.cpp) with the commentary injected: a loose ball rolling. Only with no owner (0xf582), without 0xf57a and with impulse (0x8eaa). \n Stopped play (0x8eb2): zeroes the impulse and 0x8ea9. Otherwise, with impulse 1 the ball only moves if random(1) >= random(2); impulse <= 0 does not move. \n When it moves, it spends one impulse (and one of 0x8ea9, if any) and takes a step by the direction (0x8ed8, degrees): (220, 320) x - 1; (40, 140) x + 1; (130, 230) y - 1; below 50 or above 310, y + 1. Off the pitch (x outside 0..9 or y outside 0..12): ball out (0x6cd490) on the side of 0x8eab.

Port of 0x6e0d00 (thiscall, ret 0xc, match_man.cpp): puts `pessoa` in slot `pos` (0..19) of the staff block (+0x23) via 0x6eaea0 (engine +0x12, side +0x18, `extra`). Without a person returns 0; otherwise 1. \n simplification: a slot outside 0..19 stops the game with an error in the original (match_man.cpp 0xc39); here it just returns 0. \n 0x6eaea0 (initialises the player, with random draws and effects outside the engine) is injected: in the comparison it is a tape unit (the original records; the Rust copy checks and does not run it again).

0x6e1cf0 (cdecl, match_man.cpp): the rating (i16) the staff give `pessoa` (or the person of match player `jogador` +0x69) for `clube`; -10000 with no person. \n It adds the fit (0x53ce90) as (fit^2 + 5) x 0.1 negative, the difference between the player sheet's rating +0xd and the club's reputation (x 0.002 + 1.5, between -4 and 4), the contract (0x4cf5f0: +0x44 / 75 + 0.5, adjusted by the type in +0x4f >> 4: -10, +2.5, +2, -3, -15, -20, -50) and the player sheet's +0x2f times the age factor (days of life from today's date 0xae2c90 and the birth date +0x3e, 0x54cdb0; for national teams, +0x22 x 75): above 1000 days, 1 + (days - 1000) x 0.000125. \n Then by age +0x18 (x0.5 below 18, x0.75 below 21, x0.9 below 24, x1.05 above 25), x0.9 if the days fall below (50 - +0x59) x 10, and x(0.01 x +0x5b + 0.9) with +0x5b below 10.

Port of 0x70ec80 (ret 4, match_pl.cpp), the tackle against `j`, the ball holder, with the calls that touch things outside the engine injected (0x6d6f70 commentates, 0x716e10 tires, 0x716c90 the incident of whoever lost the ball, 0x6f0630 control, 0x6cd770 the ball spills; and those inside the injury, the defence and leaving the pitch). 
 First of all it draws at random by stamina (+0x4d); it only continues if `j` has the ball (+0xf582). With `forte`, the opposing side gains 2.25 (0x6bb950) and `j`'s side +10 possession. The attack is random(+0x19c - stamina + +0x13a - random(+0x8ea9 x 50)); the challenger comes from 0x6c87e0 (incident 0x10) with the rating, the incident and the risk, and the injury in the tackle (0x6cfe10) comes right after. Without a challenger, or with the attack above the rating, `j` gets past (see the end). 
 Otherwise, with the rating below the attack and random(5), the contest is clean; otherwise the referee decides (0x6cfc60: foul, card, severity, advantage; 0x2168 in the area with +0x8ebb). A foul with 1 in 30 without risk only records the incident (0x6bb9a0); otherwise it punishes (0x6cfcd0), commentates the foul by incident, picks the card (0x1ff6 to 0x1ff9 or 0x210a by severity), marks set piece 7, a penalty (5, with 0x20e9/0x20ec without a card, -500 in the challenger's +0x35) or a free kick (6); commentates the card (0x21d9/0x21da on incident 0x2c/0x2f with advantage, 1 in 4 0x2109 and 0x20f5), a sending-off removes the challenger (0x6cda20); without a penalty it picks the taker (0x6ceb90) and commentates the kick (0x21df to 0x21e2 by position); then 0x20dd/0x20df/0x20e0/0x20d9, the challenger's team is worn down (0x6bb8d0), he tires and loses 25 stamina. 
 Clean contest: the challenger marks the incident (+0x198), counts (+4), loses 59 or 70 stamina (0x6c38c0); with the attack above the rating, `j` gets past; otherwise, in his own area by random(2), it commentates the foul and 0x20e8 to 0x20eb; otherwise the incident (0x70d430 on incident 1, which may end it; 0x1f61/0x1f62/0x1f64/0x2150/0x2164/0x1f5d). The challenger controls (0x6f0630) with +0x19c = rating - attack - 200 (+-200); below the incident's limit (400, 250 or 100) the ball spills (0x6cd770) and, without a set piece, he stays on the ground (+0x2b) or, with a penalty given, `j` suffers (0x716c90); otherwise he turns for the incident (0x6f4920), counts (+5) and, after minute 55/65, may commentate 0x21cd/0x21ce by the success average. He gains stamina (0xc8 or 0x78, doubled outside tables 2/4) and `j` adds the challenge's first byte to +0x2b; 1 in 7 commentates 0x1f41. 
 When `j` gets past: outside the area, random(+0x31) < -10 makes `j` grow (+0x1a2 x 1.05, minimum (25 - +0x5d) x 2, maximum 100, 0x211d); it counts possession (+0x8eab, +0x8d46), +0x19c gains attack - rating (+-200), the challenger adds the second byte; outside set pieces and incident 0x10 it commentates 0x2133 (with `forte`), 0x216d (with a challenger), 0x21de or 0x1f40, and zeroes +0x8ea9.

The challenger took the ball during the pass execution (0x6fad40, from 0x6fc0e5 to 0x6fc988). \n The clean contest counts for him (+0x198 = incident, +4, -0x3b/-0x46 in +0x35), the commentary (in his area, 1 in 2: the foul's and 0x20e8/0x20ea/0x20eb; otherwise by incident, with the goalkeeper's save 0x70d430 on incident 1), he controls (0x6f0630, +0x19c = rating - 400 in -200..=200), the ball spills (0x6cd770) below the incident's limit, or the success average is commentated; his gains and the passer's +0x2b.

Port of 0x6b74a0 (cdecl, match_day.cpp): after the match, walks the event list in [0xb67dc8] (cursor reset to the start; 0x68d1b0 gives the next) and handles those of the two clubs of `partida` (+0x1c, +0x20) that are not out (0x53b900), through injected calls. 
 Event: +0 person, +4 club, +8 mark, +0x13 type, +0x15 other person. Type 0x82: 0x759610 with the two persons.
